name: routeOutput
doc: 路由输出：选择集 S 上权重 w 的凸组合 `Σ_{i∈S} wᵢ•vᵢ`。
stmt: def routeOutput (S : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) : F
proof: ∑ i in S, w i • v i

name: IsTopK
doc:
`IsTopK s S k`：S 是分数 s 的 top-k 选择集——|S| = k 且 S 内每个分数
不小于 S 外每个分数（路由判定的标准刻画，平局由选择集决定）。
stmt: def IsTopK (s : ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) (k : ℕ) : Prop
proof:
S.card = k ∧ ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → s j ≤ s i

omit [DecidableEq ι] in

name: exists_argmax
doc: 有限非空指标集上 argmax 存在（`Finset.exists_max_image`）。
stmt: theorem exists_argmax (s : ι → ℝ) : ∃ i : ι, IsArgMax s i
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_max_image (Finset.univ : Finset ι) s Finset.univ_nonempty
  exact ⟨i, fun j => hi j (Finset.mem_univ j)⟩

name: exists_topk_one
doc: k=1 的 top-k 集存在（取 argmax 的单点集）——路由良定义的最小实例。
stmt: theorem exists_topk_one (s : ι → ℝ) : ∃ S : Finset ι, IsTopK s S 1
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_argmax s
  refine ⟨{i}, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp
  · intro a ha j hj
    rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at ha
    subst ha
    exact hi j

name: routeSelect
doc:
每 token 的 top-k 选择（非计算式）：给定存在性，取一个 top-k 集
（`Classical.choose`）。把「路由良定义」的存在性作为显式参数，
避免把组合存在性（分数排序）隐藏为未证前提。
stmt:
noncomputable def routeSelect (s : ι → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (h : ∃ S : Finset ι, IsTopK s S k) : Finset ι
proof:
Classical.choose h

omit [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] [DecidableEq ι] in

name: routeSelect_spec
doc: 路由选择的性质：`routeSelect s k h` 确为 top-k 集。
stmt:
theorem routeSelect_spec (s : ι → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (h : ∃ S : Finset ι, IsTopK s S k) :
    IsTopK s (routeSelect s k h) k

name: routeSelectOne
doc: k=1 的 top-1 选择（存在性由 `exists_topk_one` 给出）。
stmt: noncomputable def routeSelectOne (s : ι → ℝ) : Finset ι

name: routeSelectOne_spec
stmt: theorem routeSelectOne_spec (s : ι → ℝ) : IsTopK s (routeSelectOne s) 1
proof:
routeSelect_spec s 1 (exists_topk_one s)

omit [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] in

name: topk_one_is_argmax
doc: top-1 集的成员是分数 argmax（k=1 时 top-k 判定 = argmax）。
stmt:
theorem topk_one_is_argmax (s : ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) (hS : IsTopK s S 1)
    {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ S) : IsArgMax s i
proof:
by
  intro j
  by_cases hj : j ∈ S
  · have hle1 : S.card ≤ 1 := le_of_eq hS.1
    have hij : i = j := (Finset.card_le_one.mp hle1) i hi j hj
    rw [hij]
  · exact hS.2 i hi j hj

name: routeSelectOne_is_argmax
doc: k=1 时 top-1 选择集的成员是 argmax（路由确定性，接 RealHardAttention）。
stmt:
theorem routeSelectOne_is_argmax (s : ι → ℝ) {i : ι} (hi : i ∈ routeSelectOne s) :
    IsArgMax s i

name: routed_output_bound
stmt:
theorem routed_output_bound (S : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) (M : ℝ)
    (hw0 : ∀ i, i ∈ S → 0 ≤ w i) (hsum : ∑ i in S, w i = 1)
    (hV : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖routeOutput S w v‖ ≤ M
proof:
by
  simpa [routeOutput] using topk_output_bound S w v M hw0 hsum hV

name: routeOutput_hard
stmt:
theorem routeOutput_hard (i : ι) (v : ι → F) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : w i = 1) (hrest : ∀ j, j ≠ i → w j = 0) :
    routeOutput ({i} : Finset ι) w v = v i
proof:
by
  simpa [routeOutput] using top1_output_is_hard i v w hw hrest

name: dynamic_route_error
stmt:
theorem dynamic_route_error (S S' : Finset ι) (w w' : ι → ℝ) (v : ι → F) (M : ℝ)
    (hw0 : ∀ i, i ∈ S → 0 ≤ w i) (hsum : ∑ i in S, w i = 1)
    (hw0' : ∀ i, i ∈ S' → 0 ≤ w' i) (hsum' : ∑ i in S', w' i = 1)
    (hV : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖routeOutput S w v - routeOutput S' w' v‖ ≤ 2 * M
proof:
by
  have h1 := routed_output_bound S w v M hw0 hsum hV
  have h2 := routed_output_bound S' w' v M hw0' hsum' hV
  calc
    ‖routeOutput S w v - routeOutput S' w' v‖
        ≤ ‖routeOutput S w v‖ + ‖routeOutput S' w' v‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ M + M := add_le_add h1 h2
    _ = 2 * M := by ring

                                
                                          
              

omit [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] in

name: argmax_stable
stmt:
theorem argmax_stable (s s' : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) (γ ε : ℝ)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s j + γ ≤ s i)
    (hpert : ∀ j, |s' j - s j| ≤ ε)
    (hεγ : 2 * ε ≤ γ) :
    IsArgMax s' i
proof:
by
  intro j
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst hji
    exact le_rfl
  · have h1 : s' j ≤ s j + ε := by
      have h := hpert j
      rw [abs_le] at h
      linarith [h.2]
    have h2 : s i - ε ≤ s' i := by
      have h := hpert i
      rw [abs_le] at h
      linarith [h.1]
    have h3 := hgap j hji
    linarith

                                         
                                           
                               

omit [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] [DecidableEq ι] in

name: topk_route_stable
stmt:
theorem topk_route_stable (s s' : ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) (k : ℕ) (γ ε : ℝ)
    (hS : IsTopK s S k)
    (hgap : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → s j + γ ≤ s i)
    (hpert : ∀ j, |s' j - s j| ≤ ε)
    (hεγ : 2 * ε ≤ γ) :
    IsTopK s' S k
proof:
by
  refine ⟨hS.1, ?_⟩
  intro i hi j hj
  have h1 : s' j ≤ s j + ε := by
    have h := hpert j
    rw [abs_le] at h
    linarith [h.2]
  have h2 : s i - ε ≤ s' i := by
    have h := hpert i
    rw [abs_le] at h
    linarith [h.1]
  have h3 := hgap i hi j hj
  linarith

                                
                                  
                                                       
                                          
                                 

omit [DecidableEq ι] in

name: topk_route_stable_unique
stmt:
theorem topk_route_stable_unique (s s' : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) (γ ε : ℝ)
    (hgap : ∀ j, j ≠ i → s j + γ ≤ s i)
    (hpert : ∀ j, |s' j - s j| ≤ ε)
    (hεγ : 2 * ε < γ) :
    ∀ j : ι, IsArgMax s' j → j = i
proof:
by
  apply argmax_unique s' i
  intro j hji
  have h1 : s' j ≤ s j + ε := by
    have h := hpert j
    rw [abs_le] at h
    linarith [h.2]
  have h2 : s i - ε ≤ s' i := by
    have h := hpert i
    rw [abs_le] at h
    linarith [h.1]
  have h3 := hgap j hji
  linarith

name: route_lipschitz
stmt:
theorem route_lipschitz (s s' : ι → ℝ) (S : Finset ι) (k : ℕ) (ε : ℝ)
    (hS : IsTopK s S k)
    (hpert : ∀ j, |s' j - s j| ≤ ε)
    (hchange : ¬ IsTopK s' S k) :
    ∃ i ∈ S, ∃ j, j ∉ S ∧ s i - s j < 2 * ε
proof:
by
  by_contra hcon
  have hcon' : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j, j ∉ S → 2 * ε ≤ s i - s j := by
    intro i hi j hj
    by_contra hlt
    push_neg at hlt
    exact hcon ⟨i, hi, j, hj, hlt⟩
  apply hchange
  refine topk_route_stable s s' S k (2 * ε) ε hS ?_ hpert le_rfl
  intro i hi j hj
  have h := hcon' i hi j hj
  linarith
